name: choRT CHY NE CHOrt
source:
Dimon tried to leave his old life behind. One night with old friends reminds him of what he lost. Inside, three voices whisper, argue, and push him toward chaos. Every choice shapes his mind – and the reality around him.

[From [url=https://steenuga.itch.io/chort-chy-ne-chort]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
戴蒙试图摆脱过去的生活。与老朋友在一起的一个晚上让他想起了自己失去的一切。里面，三个声音窃窃私语，争论着，把他推向混乱。每一个选择都会塑造他的思想以及他周围的现实。

[来自[url=https://steenuga.itch.io/chort-chy-ne-chort]Itch.io[/url]]
